name: Available Financial Resources Amount 2
definition: Construct used by a central counterparty to define the size of the aggregate quantum of resources available from a clearing member.

TotalInitialMargin.name: Total Initial Margin
TotalInitialMargin.definition: Total value of the initial margin (IM) requirement for all members at the last business day of the month.

TotalPrefundedDefaultFund.name: Total Prefunded Default Fund
TotalPrefundedDefaultFund.definition: Total value of the clearing member pre-funded default fund, excluding pre-funded contributions to the default fund from the CCP.

CCPSkinInTheGame.name: CCP Skin In The Game
CCPSkinInTheGame.definition: Value of the CCP’s own contribution to the default waterfall junior to the pre-funded default fund contributions of the non-defaulting clearing members.

OtherDefaultFundContribution.name: Other Default Fund Contribution
OtherDefaultFundContribution.definition: Total value of other contributions to the pre-funded default fund, not received from clearing members, including any contribution from the CCP that is pari-passu with the default fund contributions of the non-defaulting clearing members.

UnfundedMemberCommitment.name: Unfunded Member Commitment
UnfundedMemberCommitment.definition: Total value of all legally‐bound commitments for members to provide additional resources to available to mutualise losses on exhaustion of the default fund.

UnfundedThirdPartyCommitment.name: Unfunded Third Party Commitment
UnfundedThirdPartyCommitment.definition: Total value of any third‐party commitments to provide additional resources to absorb losses, for example, from insurers.
